  • In a recent development, in GTA 6, there are five stores that are locked behind the Ultimate Edition paywall.
  • First up, there’s 305, a clothing store specializing in urban, skater-inspired clothing and gear.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that before Grand Theft Auto 6 even launched, there was some controversy online over the announcement of a $100 “Ultimate Edition” version of the game that would include access to a few exclusive shops and in-game cosmetics. So, now that GTA 6 is here and I’ve spent over 150 hours with it, I can share what’s in the Ultimate Edition, how you access this stuff, and if it’s worth upgrading from the standard $80 version of GTA 6. The short version is…eh, probably not.

In a recent development, in GTA 6, there are five stores that are locked behind the Ultimate Edition paywall. These stores include an exclusive tattoo parlor, street clothing shop, and hair salon. Now, at first, I thought it was pretty shitty of Rockstar to hide stores behind a paywall. And to be clear, it still does suck that a few shops are only accessible if you pay $20 more. But after playing GTA 6, I discovered that the world is filled with over 600 stores. There are already so many clothing, car, hair, make-up, and nail options in the base game. So the Ultimate Edition’s extra few stores don’t feel that necessary. And after actually visiting these shops and seeing what they have to offer, I don’t think people are missing out on that much.

First up, there’s 305, a clothing store specializing in urban, skater-inspired clothing and gear. There’s some alright stuff in here, including some nice-looking jeans for Jason and a cool graphic shirt or two. And a really wild fuzzy hat for Lucia. But the options in here aren’t something you need to have. You can create plenty of great and cool outfits without stopping by this Ultimate Editionâonly retailer.

In a recent development, next up is the tattoo shop Electric Fang. Of all the Ultimate Edition stores, this is the coolest one to enter. And I do think some of Electric Fang’s tat designs are solid. But again, there are so many other options in the game for ink that I’m not sure these are very necessary or worth the $20 upgrade.

In a recent development, sara’s Unisex Salon might be the best of the bunch as it offers some stylish hairdos for both Jason and Lucia. But on top of that, it offers some really nice makeup options for Lucia and cool nail art, too. I ended up using some of these options during my time as Lucia because I liked them so much. Still, again, there are so many other good options for haircuts and nail art already in GTA 6 that I’m not sure you need to spend $20 more on this version.

According to recent reports, there are also two exclusive car mod garages in GTA 6‘s Ultimate Edition. One of them, Rideout Customs, offers some really gaudy and exotic paint and accessories options. If you wanted a neon-pink car with stripes painted to look like cheetah print, well, this is the place for you.

The other mod shop, One-Eyed Willie’s, is more useful. It offers up some really nice off-road options. There aren’t nearly as many off-road modding options in GTA 6 as there are for street cars, so losing out on access to this in the base game is a shame. I also love that One-Eyed Willie’s offers up a random paint job for every car in the game, including non-off-road vehicles, that you can only see once it’s applied. I brought my Banshee into the shop, and it received this pretty pink design that I loved.

The Ultimate Edition also includes some unique free clothing items based on characters from an in-universe cartoon you can watch. These clothes are fine. I guess if you like the show a lot, they might be fun to wear. But…eh.

It has been revealed that beyond the stores and cosmetics, there are some exclusive vehicles you get access to in the Ultimate Edition, but some of these are only available during chapter one for story reasons. The only thing from the Ultimate Edition I used regularly and still use often when I play is the Vapid off-road truck. It’s fast as heck, a great option for driving on the dirt, and can be upgraded into a beast that can hold a lot of stolen loot. There’s also a classic car scavenger hunt side mission hidden behind the paywall, but after 150 hours I’ve barely interacted with that thing.

Answering the big question of “Is the Ultimate Edition worth it?” is tricky, because it depends entirely on what you value and your taste for fashion and cosmetics. I’ve provided some samples of what’s on offer and how it fits into the larger GTA 6 world.

In a recent development, my opinion is that if you can afford the extra $20, a few bits of the Ultimate Edition are nice and worth the upgrade. But for the most part, if you just want to play Grand Theft Auto 6 to enjoy the open world and its story, you don’t need this upgrade. You’ll have a great time with the base game and never think to yourself, “Boy, I wish there were 30 more shirts and a few more cars in this!” GTA 6 is already massive. Don’t worry about making it a bit bigger.

The best way to play is just to experience the game, even if most of us are too internet-pilled to do that.

People don't like having to scroll a substantial number back and forth to deposit a specific amount.

It's a funny ad poking fun at another significant franchise, but is a bit awkward as Rockstar deals with its own employees trying to form a union.

I could see an HBO TV adaptation of Red Dead Redemption making sense.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Shannon Beador shared a poignant post as she remembered her beloved late dog Archie ahead of the holiday season.

Posting via her Instagram on Friday, November 20, the Real Housewives of Orange County star, 62, shared a carousel of photos featuring Archie, who died in May.

“I’ve been wanting to post about Archie but it has been very difficult for me to put anything together. And as Thanksgiving approaches, it’s important for me to acknowledge how grateful my girls and I are for Archie’s presence in our lives,” Shannon wrote in the post’s lengthy caption..

In a recent development, she continued, “Archie passed away five days after our finale party was filmed. It happened so quickly. I was grateful that Stella was able to come home from Paris to say her goodbyes.”.

Shannon went on to recall Archie’s final moments before he passed away shortly after his brain cancer diagnosis.

It has been revealed that “Archie had been in the hospital and was so drugged, he couldn’t even stand up. We took him off all the medication and he spent his last day doing all of his favorite things,” she divulged. “Archie went to the beach, ate every type of food that he loved, and spent time sitting in the park.”.

In May, Shannon shared the sad news of Archie’s death, which came nine days after the Bravo star unveiled her pet had been diagnosed with brain cancer.

According to recent reports, “Heaven has a newly introduced special angel. Archie passed away yesterday and the girls and I are heartbroken. For the last 10 years, Archie wasn’t just my dog — he was my constant comfort, protector, best friend and truly the real “man” in my life,” she wrote.

Shannon continued: “I have been through so many highs and lows, and through every good time and every heartache, Archie was always by my side and loved me the same way every single day. Never judging me and always giving pure, loyal, and unconditional love.”.

The reality star thanked her followers for their well wishes and added, “There is such a void in our household right now.”.

In her earlier posts, Shannon, who adopted Archie in 2016, explained she was looking into treatments for Archie.

“I know my posts about my dogs are usually fun and silly, but today I wanted to share something more serious,” Shannon shared on May 5. “After experiencing multiple seizures, Archie has been diagnosed with brain cancer.”.

She continued, “Our heart aches for our sweet Archie. He means the world to the girls and I. We are going to do everything we can to help him fight this.”.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that I recently switched music streamers from Apple Music to Tidal. I like Tidal's strict anti-AI features, the fact that it pays higher royalties to artists than other major streamers, and its focus on high quality audio. I wrote a post featuring eight hacks for Tidal customers, but I wanted to highlight one in particular: How to transfer playlists without paying anything.

Download your playlist as a .txt file. You can do this directly from Apple Music under File>Library>Export Playlist. You can't from Spotify, but the free site Exportify will download any of your playlists as a spreadsheet file you can save.

Install Python on your system. Double click "install certificates" in the folder that opens after installation.

Download this script. Save it in the same file as your playlist.

It has been revealed that run the script: (For Mac, open Terminal. For Windows, go to the Command prompt. Type python3 on a Mac or py on Windows.) Drag the script into the terminal window and press enter. It should ask you to drag your downloaded playlist into the window next.

Sign in to Tidal. Hit "Approve" to give permission for Tidal to run the script.

In a recent development, have a banana. The script is going to search for all the songs on your playlist and match them to Tidal's library, so it can take a little while. I tested it with a playlist from Apple Music with 2,397 songs. It took about 20 minutes and found 2,362 of my tracks, a 99% success rate.

Fix the leftovers: The program creates two separate text files for "orphans." One is songs it couldn't find and one is songs it might be worth double-checking manually.

If everything goes well, your large playlist should be available on Tidal.

Note: The script uses a community-created library to talk to Tidal, so it could stop working if Tidal changes things up.

Use of generative AI in game dev remains as contentious as it does ubiquitous—a recent GDC report found that around 40% of devs use AI, but more than half think its influence has been negative. Ubisoft is continuing to double down on the technology, this time with Motherbrain, a latest subsidiary fashioned from the team behind its "first playable generative AI experience.".

As reported by VGC, Motherbrain's purpose is to develop "AI for gameplay innovation, supporting all game creators in developing groundbreaking experiences … Its current focus is on newly introduced player experiences, smart NPCs with memory and AI game masters that manage large scale systemic worlds," according to an earnings report which was released Thursday.

The information comes at a turbulent time for the publishing giant, which just laid off 166 employees even after Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced "outperformed expectations." A sweeping internal overhaul earlier this year saw the company reorganize its workforce into a throng of "creative houses," a decision which led to swathes of layoffs and six project cancellations, including the Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time Remake.

In a recent development, it's not clear what Motherbrain are at work on, in specific terms, right now, but there may be some clues in its past work. That playable AI "experience" I mentioned earlier is none other than Teammates, an R&D project based on a prior experiment with uncanny AI "neo-NPCs.".

In a recent development, teammates aimed to allow players to command NPC squadmates in a rudimentary shooter game with a microphone, and using AI, have those squadmates react believably. It's not far off, at least conceptually, from what we've seen in games like Where Winds Meet and Fortnite, both of which have experimented with AI-powered NPCs.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Newly introduced arrivals are landing in the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog this month, but at the same time, you can also expect a few departures from that gaming library. Fortunately, the number of games leaving soon are on the smaller side, as there'll be only three exits in total. Unfortunately, one of those games that you're running out of time to play through the Game Catalog is a massive and pretty fun fantasy title, so get those hours in while you can. PlayStation Plus Game Catalog games leaving soon Granblue Fantasy Relink Granblue Fantasy Relink Somerville Fade to Silence This month's biggest departure is Granblue Fantasy Relink, a massive fantasy game with a storybook art style, cinematic boss fights, and a large roster of characters who all possess unique abilities to master. First released in February 2024, Granblue Fantasy Relink is built around real-time combat and flashy team-up mechanics, making for a visually striking experience overall. While the story isn't much to write home about, it's the gameplay and worldbuilding where this Granblue spin-off shines, and it got even better earlier this year with the Endless Ragnarok expansion. In comparison, Somerville is a story-rich puzzle game that's oozing atmosphere with its slick art direction, and Fade to Silence is a single-player and co-op survival-crafting adventure set in a post-apocalyptic world that is feeling the chill of an eternal winter. While the Game Catalog is going to be a little poorer without those three titles, it is getting some great games this month. Death Stranding 2: On the Beach is the headline act, and it'll be joined by several more titles like Atomfall, Dragon Quest 3 HD-2D Remake, and Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii. All PlayStation Plus subscribers can also grab a trio of freebies between now and November 30: Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider 4-6 Remastered, and Monster Train 2.

💡 Key Takeaways

  • First off, let’s start with the whole reason I wanted to write this blog.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Grand Theft Auto 6GTA 6Rockstar Games.

I’ve played over 150 hours of Grand Theft Auto 6. You might think I’ve seen it all, and that I know everything there is to know about the game. Nope! I’m still discovering latest mechanics, features, and open-world moments after all this time. This includes some very handy control shortcuts I recently learned about that will make your life in Vice City a little easier.

First off, let’s start with the whole reason I wanted to write this blog. Did you know that you can quickly toggle your car radio on and off without having to enter a submenu? All you have to do is double-tap left on the D-pad, and Jason or Lucia will turn the radio on or off.

I had no idea you could do this until I saw people sharing it on Reddit. The game doesn’t explain this shortcut, as far as I can tell. I couldn’t even find it mentioned in the in-game help menu, which does include lots of other nifty tips and tricks.

Here’s another trick I just learned about: You can double-tap the circle/B button while in a car to cycle the headlights between off, high beams, and low beams.

It has been revealed that I thought you had to hold left on the D-pad to open up the vehicle submenu to turn off the headlights, but nope! And again, this isn’t mentioned in the help menu and if a prompt appeared during the normal course of the game to explain this, I and many others must have missed it.

Here’s another useful thing you can do inside cars: If you double-tap the triangle/Y button while driving, you’ll exit the vehicle without turning off the engine or radio.

In a recent development, GTA 6‘s help menu does call this out and mentions you can do this at speed to have your car drive into something while you roll out the side to safely. But again, I can’t remember a single time when the game forced me to do this or taught me that it was possible. I learned from a random post online. I guess I should have dug through the help menu more, but come on, who is doing that in Grand Theft Auto?

Another feature mentioned in the help menu that I just learned about is the ability to click the right stick in and yell at nearby drivers. Rockstar refers to this as the road rage button, and it’s a good thing to have in a game where NPC drivers, inspired by real Floridian drivers, suck shit and drive like maniacs.

One more useful control trick: You can double-tap the triangle/Y button while driving a boat to get up and walk around the deck while the boat keeps on cruising.

The next time I boot up GTA 6, I’m going to start double-tapping random buttons during different parts of the game to see what other hidden shortcuts and control options Rockstar has buried in this massive game. And if you want some more useful hidden features, check out this blog about how to flip cars and sit anywhere you want in GTA 6.Â.

If you were curious how accurate the utility towers in Grand Theft Auto 6 the answer appears to be: Very.

The best way to play is just to experience the game, even if most of us are too internet-pilled to do that.

People don't like having to scroll a substantial number back and forth to deposit a specific amount.

It's a funny ad poking fun at another big franchise, but is a bit awkward as Rockstar deals with its own employees trying to form a union.

I could see an HBO TV adaptation of Red Dead Redemption making sense.

It really comes down to how many extra shirts, tattoo designs, and car options you want.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

After days of rumors circulating about Kate Middleton’s possible participation in the trip to India, confirmation came only at the last minute. This news came as a surprise in many ways, even though the princess’s presence was expected. Her involvement in this tour of India deserves attention, especially in light of the increasingly important role she plays alongside Prince William, who will be king. The trip to India, significant in its own right, also included an important meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, aimed at strengthening relations between the United Kingdom and India. This high-profile diplomatic meeting was added after it was confirmed that Modi would return in time from his trip to the Philippines.

The Prince and Princess of Wales arrive at the Earthshot ceremony.

In a recent development, kate’s participation in the royal tour was made official by Kensington Palace only the day before departure to allow the princess to assess her condition right up until the last minute and determine whether she could handle such a demanding trip, following her recovery. But once she arrived in Mumbai, Catherine proved she was ready to do more than initially planned. The princess appeared, as always, impeccable and smiling—perhaps even more so than usual—in her customary understated and polished style. She greeted the crowd and met with people who had come to see her, participating in events alongside her husband.

It has been revealed that from the first day of this three-day tour—which began on the anniversary of their official engagement— Kate immediately displayed her characteristic good-natured spirit, evident in past tours as well, by joining Prince William in a game of gully cricket—a street version of the sport—alongside local children and teenagers. Serving as host was Sachin Tendulkar, an Indian sports legend whom the couple had already met during their previous visit to the country in 2016. The two princes put their skills to the test with little formality. They then took a ride on the Mumbai metro—a scene we’d already seen in London in candid photos when the Princess of Wales traveled on a bus in celebration of London Poppy Day.

The Princess of Wales at the awards ceremony.

According to recent reports, the highlight was the awards ceremony in Mumbai on the evening of the second day, when the Princess of Wales unexpectedly took the stage to deliver a speech dedicated to the power of nature, health, and healing. Her speech was kept secret until the last moment, so much so that not even the celebrities and other guests in attendance knew the Princess of Wales would be speaking. “Nature is precious,” the princess noted. “We are not separate from it. We are part of it, deeply connected in ways both visible and unseen…the health of the planet and our natural world is inseparable from our own, and when it thrives, so do we,” she continued. “I have seen firsthand how nature has the power to heal and enrich our daily lives, but so much remains under threat.” “There will be good days and bad days, that it will take time.".

Catherine then presented the award in the “Protect and Restore Nature” category, dedicated to the protection and restoration of ecosystems. “The people we’re celebrating tonight are a huge part of that story. Their work will inspire and create seismic change that will improve lives for generations to come,” she remarked.

The Prince and Princess of Wales at the awards ceremony.

According to recent reports, over the past three days, William and Kate have been busy meeting about sustainability, innovation, transportation, culture, and relations between the two countries. William is, in fact, assuming an increasingly prominent role on the international stage, supporting the United Kingdom’s diplomatic relations through his travels, which Middleton’s presence reinforced. This time, however, it was not simply a princess accompanying her husband on an official visit, but a woman who, after her illness and a long hiatus from major trips abroad, chose to return to her rightful role—and one the public has long expected her to fill.

The Prince and Princess of Wales with some Earthshot Prize winners.

According to recent reports, it’s worth noting that this is the first time in four years—since her illness—that Kate has accompanied Prince William on an official overseas mission. The last such occasion was in December 2022, when the couple traveled to Boston, Massachusetts, for the Earthshot Prize ceremony. Her participation in the trip to India thus reflects her desire to gradually resume her international role, as well as her awareness of just how important her presence is to the monarchy.

After her cancer diagnosis in 2024, Catherine prioritized her health and family, returning to public engagements without rushing things. However, her trip to Reggio Emilia, Italy, last May marked an crucial first step. On that occasion, she appeared visibly engaged and enthusiastic, and in subsequent statements, she hinted at her desire to travel more and gradually resume international engagements. “So I’m so glad it went well for her. I think she came back buzzing.” William remarked, describing his wife’s mood after that trip. Court circles had also hinted that Catherine wished to gradually resume a more active schedule.

The Prince and Princess of Wales at the 2026 Earthshot Prize ceremony.

Her return to work, however, was approached gradually, respecting the time needed for her recovery. It’s a journey that Kate herself described with great sincerity in a recent interview published last week in Country Life, a magazine for which Prince William served as guest editor. “I was told in hospital that my recovery would not be linear. There will be good days and bad days, that it will take time,” the princess mentioned, emphasizing that recovery does not necessarily proceed in a steady and predictable manner. India, therefore, did not come as a complete surprise. Rather, it was the realization of a desire that Middleton had already begun to express, and that the princess agreed to undertake such a demanding trip indicates she felt ready to take the next step.

The Prince and Princess of Wales in India.

Before the trip, Kensington Palace issued a statement emphasizing how much the princess cares about her husband’s environmental initiative and how meaningful it was for her to return to participate in the ceremony in person. “She’s enormously proud of what he’s achieved, and it has been particularly special for them to experience this moment together. They are very much a team.”.

Industry observers note that this refers to the project’s growth; since her last participation in Boston in 2022, it has significantly expanded its international reach and the impact of the initiatives it supports. “This year’s program in Mumbai promises to be the biggest and most ambitious yet, and she’s excited to see first-hand just how far some of it has come and meet some of the extraordinary people behind that success.” The spokesperson then recalled the couple’s previous trip to India in 2016, explaining that both have particularly fond memories of that visit. “The prince and princess are both really looking forward to what promises to be a fantastic week in India. They have such fond memories of their last visit together in 2016, and are excited to be returning a decade later.”.

According to recent reports, as mentioned, the most vital diplomatic event of the tour took place on November 18 in Fresh Delhi, where Prince William and Kate met with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This was the only occasion during the visit when the royal couple left Mumbai, the city that hosted most of their scheduled engagements. Modi returned to the Indian capital specifically for this occasion after attending a major international summit in Manila, Philippines, to take part in the bilateral talks.

A spokesperson for Kensington Palace had emphasized the strategic importance of relations between the two countries, characterized by deep and ever-growing ties in numerous sectors, which include trade, investment, defense, security, technology, education, and culture. Kate’s presence alongside William during the meeting was considered particularly significant. “This meeting reflects the importance of that relationship, as well as the role their royal highnesses can play in celebrating and strengthening the ties between our two countries.”.

In a recent development, “For the prince, it also represents another significant engagement as he continues to take on a growing role on the international stage. We’ve seen him increasingly support the UK’s diplomatic relationships through his overseas engagements, and this meeting will provide an opportunity to build on those connections at the highest level.”.

The Prince of Wales on the Mumbai Metro.

According to recent reports, india, after all, holds a special place in the history of relations between the British monarchy and the Commonwealth. King Charles has visited the country numerous times, on both official and private occasions, strengthening a personal and institutional relationship over the years. For William and Catherine, however, this trip represented an opportunity to build a direct relationship with a nation destined to play an increasingly important role in the international balance of power.

A close-up of the Prince and Princess of Wales.

With a population of over 1.4 billion people, India is now the world’s most populous country and one of the fastest-growing economies. Hosting the Earthshot Prize meant engaging a potentially massive audience on issues of environmental sustainability, resource conservation, and innovative solutions to combat climate change.

A beautiful image of the Prince and Princess of Wales.

It has been revealed that for William and Kate, returning to India also meant revisiting a country to which they are bound by personal memories. As mentioned, their last visit was in April 2016, when the Prince and Princess of Wales—then the Duke and Duchess of Cambridge—undertook an official tour of India and Bhutan at the request of the British government. During that trip, they visited Mumbai, met with representatives from India’s cultural and sports communities, and traveled to Agra, where they admired the Taj Mahal.

Right in front of the famous mausoleum—a symbol of eternal love—William and Kate sat on the same white marble bench where, 24 years earlier, Lady Diana, Princess of Wales, posed during a visit to India. That photograph of Diana, portrayed alone in front of the monument, became one of the most iconic images of her public life. Taken in 1992, when her marriage to Charles was going through a deep crisis, many interpreted it as a visual representation of her loneliness. In 2016, William and Kate’s decision to recreate that shot inevitably brought Diana to mind, adding a personal and symbolic dimension to their visit.

It has been revealed that for Catherine, therefore, this trip is above all a upcoming step on her journey back to public life following her illness. Not a demonstration of recovery to be celebrated as a race against time, but an opportunity to resume playing an notable role while moving at her own pace. And to stand once again alongside William on a mission that concerns not only the future of the monarchy, but also that of the planet.

The Prince and Princess of Wales in 2016.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Original Home Alone director Chris Columbus doesn’t think a reboot of the hit Christmas movie can work without its late star, Catherine O’Hara.

The director shared his opinion about continuing the Home Alone universe with Variety on Friday, November 20 — shortly before reports of a potential Home Alone reboot broke.

Sources indicate that “Catherine, as I’ve always said, is 50% of Home Alone,” Columbus, 68, told the outlet. “There’s the yin and yang of Home Alone: Catherine O’Hara and Macaulay Culkin.”.

He further explained, “Without those two in the film, there is no film, because they create the emotional epicenter of that film.”.

Before he was aware that another Home Alone with Culkin, 46, could be in the works, Columbus added the original cast — as opposed to new actors — would be key to its success.

“I think you potentially could still entertain the idea of doing another Home Alone with the cast,” Columbus added. “Not any of these ridiculous follow-ups to the first. And I only say ridiculous because it’s weird with filmmakers. They don’t understand why that cast works so well. It’s always about the cast. It’s like The Goonies. It’s about the cast.”.

However, he still believed the mother-son dynamic between O’Hara and Culkin’s character was crucial.

“It was really about Catherine and Macaulay, if anyone ever wanted to do a sequel and unfortunately that can’t happen now,” he stated.

According to recent reports, multiple outlets reported on Friday that Culkin is in talks to return to the Home Alone franchise in a sequel developed by Disney and 20th Century Studios. Seth Rogen and his producing and writing partner, Evan Goldberg, are reportedly attached to pen the script, which is based on an idea that Culkin himself pitched to Disney in recent months.

The plot centers on Culkin’s character, Kevin McCallister, as a father, according to Deadline. Us reached out to reps for Disney for comment.

Recent findings suggest that as a child, Culkin starred in the original 1990 comedy directed by Columbus. The classic holiday movie follows 8-year-old Kevin, who is accidentally left alone at his parents’ home in Chicago while his family heads off on a Christmas vacation in Paris. Kevin must fend for himself and defend his home when a pair of burglars attempts a robbery.

Culkin reprised his role in the 1992 sequel, Home Alone 2: Lost in Fresh York, which finds Kevin alone in New York after he accidentally boards the wrong plane.

Several sequels without Culkin followed, including 1997’s Home Alone 3, Home Alone 4 in 2002, Home Alone: The Holiday Heist in 2012 and the latest incarnation, 2021’s Home Sweet Home Alone.

O’Hara, who played Kevin’s mother, died in January at the age of 71. The actress’ cause of death was listed as a pulmonary embolism, a blood clot in the lungs, with rectal cancer as the underlying cause.

In a recent development, “Mama. I thought we had time,” Culkin wrote via Instagram at the time. “I wanted more. I wanted to sit in a chair next to you. I heard you but I had so much more to say. I love you. I’ll see you later.”.

In an interview with The Gentleman’s Journal in May, Culkin opened up about how O’Hara’s death affected him.

According to recent reports, “When Catherine passed away in January, that hit me,” Culkin told the outlet. “That hit me pretty good ’cause, you know, it was just too soon. And I felt that we had unfinished business.”.

He continued, “I definitely feel like I had unfinished business with her, you know? I feel like I owed her a favor — and I don’t like having an outstanding debt.”.

Latest Update: Eight Important Router Settings You Should Check (or Change)

📅 16 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (700 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Lifehacker

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Your router is a key piece of your home network, as it connects all of your other devices to the internet.
  • Your router's security protocol determines how encryption and authentication work to protect data that's transmitted over your network.
  • It has been revealed that some routers ship with factory default login credentials, which are the username and password you need to access your device's admin dashboard.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Your router is a key piece of your home network, as it connects all of your other devices to the internet. This also makes it a highly valuable target for attackers and can leave your data vulnerable—especially if you simply plug your router in with its default settings unchanged. Whether your router is brand new or it's been a while since you audited your existing setup, these are the key settings to check and change right now.

Your router's security protocol determines how encryption and authentication work to protect data that's transmitted over your network. WPA3 Personal is the newest standard and the most secure, so if it's available on your router, enable it. It's compatible with devices that support Wi-Fi 6. Some older devices may not work with WPA3, in which case the WPA2/WPA3 Transitional mixed mode is a good alternative. At minimum, set your router to WPA2 Personal (AES).

It has been revealed that some routers ship with factory default login credentials, which are the username and password you need to access your device's admin dashboard. (This is not the same as your network name or wifi password, which you set up later.) Default router passwords are searchable online, which leaves your router's admin settings open to anyone. Once you get into your dashboard for the first time, change the default credentials and enable two-factor authentication for your admin account if available.

Sources indicate that while some newer routers do have unique, device-specific defaults, it's a good idea to check this setting and ensure it's secure. If you're prompted to create custom admin credentials during the setup process, do it.

Your network name, or SSID, is how your network appears when you search for available wifi. By default, this may be the name of the router brand or a short string of characters, but you should choose something unique to your network. Make sure there's no identifying personal information, such as your name or house number. While you may be tempted to hide your network and obscure your SSID, this may actually make your information less secure, so keep this setting disabled. You can, however, add "_nomap" to the end of your network name, which prevents your router's physical coordinates from being mapped by location databases.

Industry observers note that the password to access your network should also be unique and secure and should not include obvious personal information. One option to keep it memorable and easy to type is to create a passphrase using five to seven unrelated words that, combined, have at least 16 characters.

Two additional settings that leave your network vulnerable are Wi-Fi Protected Setup (WPS) and Universal Plug and Play (UPnP). The former lets people connect to your network with a PIN, which can be vulnerable to brute-force attacks. The latter allows smart devices to easily connect to your network—but this also allows malware to spread more readily. You may need to have UPnP on in order to connect devices initially but should disable it afterward.

According to recent reports, any easy win for your network security is segmenting traffic to different networks, so if one is compromised, the data on the others remain unaffected. Many wifi routers have a "guest mode," which creates a separate SSID and password that you can share with visitors instead of giving them your primary network credentials. You can also set up a separate network for all of your smart home and IoT devices so exploitable vulnerabilities in these devices don't put your computers, phones, and other connected devices at risk too.

Sources indicate that routers run a type of software—called firmware—just like any other device. Firmware controls the router's core functions and is not immune to vulnerabilities, which can be exploited by bad actors. And, just like other types of software, manufacturers occasionally push updates to patch these flaws. Check your router's dashboard to see if automatic updates are toggled on. Some devices require an opt-in for auto updates during setup, so you should enable them if they are off. Some routers may even require manual updates—in this case, set a monthly or quarterly (at minimum) calendar reminder to check for patches.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that video game consoles are more expensive than ever, but sales are growing regardless, at least in the US. Circana has released its report for US video game industry sales in October, confirming that PS5 unit sales increased by 5% compared to October 2025. That's despite the average selling price of a PS5 increasing by 13%. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4FatSqS3VYY Xbox Series X|S unit sales jumped by 10% in October 2026 compared to October 2025, and the average selling price rose by 29% year-over-year. The Switch 2 was October 2026's top console in unit and dollar sales, and it remains 2026's best-performing console by those measurements, followed by PS5. However, Circana did not break out the specifics for Switch 2 unit sales or average selling price changes. Total hardware spending in the US on game consoles was up by 2%, reaching $357 million. Higher pricing drove the dollar sales growth, Circana stated, noting that PS5 dollar sales rose by 20% and Xbox Series X|S jumped by 42%. However, Switch 2 sales, measured by dollar sales, fell by 11%. Looking back to September 2026, PS5 hardware dollar sales grew by 43%, while spending on Xbox Series X|S dropped by 2% and Switch 2 fell by 12%. It will be interesting to see the November US hardware data when it comes in, as experts have said the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S could get a jolt in sales from people buying systems to play GTA 6. However, Circana has warned that sales might not be as strong as expected due to the increased prices. Microsoft, Sony, and Nintendo have raised prices on their consoles due in part to the ongoing memory and component shortages from the AI buildout. Tariffs have also played a role. On the subject of tariffs, all three received refunds from the government after the Supreme Court deemed the tariffs illegal, but those companies are keeping the money and not giving anything back to you. The companies argued that people who paid more knew what they were doing and don't deserve to get any money back.

Every kiss stolen between missions and military meetings is making up for years of âwill-they-wonât-theysâ and all that time they spent not even speaking to each other during Mass Effect 2. Now, theyâre finally considering a future with one another that they donât even know if theyâll get to have. The galaxy rests on their shoulders, but their sights are set on something smaller: the chance to spend just one more second of time together after all the time they foolishly wasted getting to this point. This all culminates in the twoâs first and only on-screen âI love youâ as Shepard makes a dash for the Citadel at the end of Mass Effect 3, hoping that whatever he finds there might guarantee that future, or, if it canât, at least create one that Kaidan is alive to see. â Kenneth Shepard.

As a Mass Effect diehard, I have a soft spot for KOTORâs Carth because heâs voiced by Kaidan actor Raphael Sbarge, but I will also give his romance, in which he reckons with the loss of one life and tries to imagine another, its flowers as one of BioWareâs early examples of a relationship tinged with grief and loss. He had a family once, and he lost them in an orbital strike by the Republic; his desire for revenge consumed him. Like many good revenge stories, KOTOR sees its would-be avenger reckon with what comes after the deed has been done, and if youâre pursuing a relationship with him, it might be you. BioWare games have you meet people at various stages of their lives, and thereâs something poignant about knowing that you might not have been your partnerâs first love, and that theyâve lived lives full of both triumph and tragedy. Carth canât change the past, but youâre there to help him envision something new waiting for him on the other side of this struggle. â Kenneth Shepard.

Industry observers note that the Fenris romance is like a recipe that calls for you to add a little bit of spice, but you accidentally pour the entire bottle of hot sauce into the concoction and then realize thatâs exactly what it needed. Fenris is an angry person, having been forced into slavery under the Tevinter magisters and conditioned to view magic with skepticism at best, disdain at worst. So, what if he fell in love with a mage that he could not have been more ideologically opposed to? The Rivalry Romance, in which Dragon Age II protagonist Hawke repeatedly calls him out on his absolute hatred of magic consumers,hits with the kind of intensity your favorite AO3 fanfic can only dream of. Itâs hot, heavy, heart-wrenching and, if you commit to doing the work to trust one another, has a happy ending.Â  Well, as happy as Dragon Age II can muster, I suppose. Trust in the face of a lifetime of conditioning is hard to come by, and allowing yourself to be vulnerable to something youâve been taught doesnât see you as a person feels downright impossible. Yet Fenris and Hawke find a way. â Kenneth Shepard.

Industry observers note that despite the fantastical framing, Dorianâs love story in Dragon Age: Inquisition is one that too many queer people are familiar with. He comes from an unsupportive family, having fled his home in Tevinter after his sexuality interfered with their planned legacy. Despite Dorianâs self-assured nature, entering a relationship with him can sometimes feel like stepping into a minefield filled with past traumas, only for them to blow up in your face. But what keeps the relationship afloat is his desire to unpack all the damage thatâs been done with the Inquisitor by his side, and build something better in the space thatâs left. Every queer person has some level of trauma to overcome, and even if he, like most of us, canât deal with his trauma perfectly, his desire to do the work, and do it with someone, is why Dorianâs relationship works, even though heâs been given every reason to believe it canât. â Kenneth Shepard.

  • The GTA 6 launch looks set to break several records, as the digital-only game appears on track to be a major critical and commercial hit.

  • "When you buy a game, you should be able to sell it, trade it, or lend it to a friend," Cohen said to Bloomberg.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

The GTA 6 launch looks set to break several records, as the digital-only game appears on track to be a major critical and commercial hit. Right on cue, GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen has criticized publishers that forgo a traditional physical release as a business strategy that hurts consumers and GameStop's bottom line, without explicitly mentioning GTA 6 publisher Take-Two Interactive. "When you buy a game, you should be able to sell it, trade it, or lend it to a friend," Cohen noted to Bloomberg. "Unquestionably, the decision to move to all-digital has hurt consumers, and it's also hurt GameStop. Of course they don't like [trade-ins] because removing a used copy eliminates an alternative to buying fresh. They're taking away competition." https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RQvBOySNq1U Cohen's comments come in the wake of GTA 6 being a digital-only release--the "physical" edition includes a download code for it. It's also somewhat ironic for Cohen to defend physical games, given the GameStop boss's July remarks that physical video games were "irrelevant" to GameStop's business strategy. That business model has relied heavily on secondhand game sales, and none of those profits ever made their way back to the original publishers. At the moment, GameStop claims that selling video game software makes up the smallest part of its business. But in the case of GTA 6? Going digital probably made financial sense for Take-Two Interactive and developer Rockstar Games. The entire game clocks in at over 211GB, which means three standard 100GB Ultra HD Blu-ray discs would have been needed to house GTA 6 in its launch-day entirety--although realistically, Take-Two probably would have opted for one disc and forced consumers to download the rest of the game. That would have raised costs, and it wouldn't be unlikely to imagine Take-Two fearing the discs being reverse-engineered for secrets ahead of GTA 6's launch. Going digital essentially removed those risks, and while PlayStation and Xbox do take a cut of profits for hosting the game on their servers. According to Sensor Tower, GTA 6 sales for PS5 alone have reached $1.38 billion in revenue so far, which means Sony is profiting handsomely from those sales. Retailers are still entitled to a share of the profits for stocking the code-in-a-box version of the game on their shelves, and once you start to factor in distribution costs, Take-Two's reasoning starts to make sense. The publisher says 98% of its business is digital, but it's not ruling out a proper physical GTA 6 edition in the future. Latest Update: Christmas in July? Why Stop There?

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • It has been revealed that why do we let something like the calendar dictate our holidays?
  • In a recent development, consider it!
  • If the holiday season has wrapped by February 14, the weeks following are the shoulder season.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that why do we let something like the calendar dictate our holidays? The fact that Thanksgiving and Christmas are just four weeks apart means by the time you’ve returned from November family visits, unpacked, shopped, decorated, done the party circuit, bought gifts, and maybe—maybe—worked for a few days, you have to turn around and celebrate again. It’s exhausting and expensive and too warp-speed to feel like that much of a good time. I’m not arguing to ban Christmas—which I am using as a catchall for nondenominational winter holidays, however that looks to you—what I am proposing is, in fact, much more exciting. I think we should switch the dates of Christmas and Valentine’s Day.

In a recent development, consider it! Instead of condensing so much effort and so much merriment into such a ludicrously small window at the very end of the year with nothing but the bland hell of winter ahead of us, let’s maximize our time by stretching it out. Valentine’s Day is for romance, whether that means watching Bridget Jones’s Diary with friends, eating overpriced meals at candlelit restaurants, making cards, or mainlining chocolates. So on December 24, celebrate platonic love with friends—à la Galentine’s Day, except we should think of a better name—and maybe go on a date on the 25th. If that date goes well: bam! You now have a plus-one to a Newly introduced Year’s Eve party and a midnight make out partner.

If the holiday season has wrapped by February 14, the weeks following are the shoulder season. Life is slow. But by the time everyone trickles back home from watching Die Hard in their pajamas or shopping post-Christmas sales or going to the gym, you only have to survive one month until the sweet relief of spring in late March. Nothing makes more sense for how to survive the long nights and cold of winter.

Recent findings suggest that so we go all-in on spring. Mid-April is when it likely won’t snow again; around then you no longer need heat—at least in Upcoming York City—so let’s make that a national holiday celebrating warm weather with seasonal bouquets (tulips, lilacs, peonies), foraged ramps, and maybe specials on dry-cleaning winter coats or sales on shearling boots.

But why stop there? We in America could take a page from France, where May can have four(!) public holidays as a kind of summer practice run. I’d be more than happy to celebrate VE Day in solidarity: Liberté, égalité, holiday! In our version, maybe botanical gardens will be free to the public for picnics. Maybe amusement parks will be gratis? Maybe lobster rolls and strawberry shortcake will be handed out on the street? Can the first summer blockbuster of May be an annual event with free popcorn? This month of long weekends will culminate in Memorial Day barbecues, which is a perfect bookend to summer with Labor Day—no notes.

Let’s keep summer luxurious, so summer Fridays will not be at the discretion of employers but mandated by the government for those three months. The Fourth of July can stay where it is with the caveat that if it rains, we get to observe it on the next day forecast for hot dog weather. Nothing important happens in August—phone it in, federal holiday or not. Labor Day stays, of course. The week following it in Upcoming York is Fashion Week, which runs concurrently with the US Open for tennis—very busy but very social. We’re going to adopt that nationwide as a festive season soft launching the country into fall.

And finally, let’s turn our attention to that somber stretch of time between early September and Thanksgiving. We don’t get enough time off, so we will move Presidents’ Day from February to mid-October for another much-needed holiday. Then cook a massive turkey dinner on Thanksgiving, see your extended family, watch football, whatever, and delight in the fact that you don’t have to do it again until February. But start figuring out your Valentine’s Day dates now—those prix fixe dinners with chocolate lava cakes really book up fast these days.

Why GTA 6 Doesn’t Include Disney World

📅 19 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (678 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Gamespot

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sources indicate that walt Disney World is synonymous with Florida, but the iconic theme park doesn't show up in Rockstar's GTA 6, which takes place in a fictional Florida called Leonida.
  • According to recent reports, walt Disney World is synonymous with Florida, but the iconic theme park doesn't show up in Rockstar's GTA 6, which takes place in a fictional Florida called Leonida.
  • Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson said the decision to came down to resources and story reasons.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that walt Disney World is synonymous with Florida, but the iconic theme park doesn't show up in Rockstar's GTA 6, which takes place in a fictional Florida called Leonida. Many are wondering why, especially when GTA: Vice City had its own parody of the theme park--Fun World--many years ago. Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson stated the decision to came down to resources and story reasons. “A theme park would represent a lot of work that we didn’t have, and we didn’t have a strong narrative reason to send them there,” he told VGC. Nelson added that Rockstar isn't known to cut corners, so if GTA 6 were to have its own version of Walt Disney World, it would be a "fully functioning theme park," and that just wasn't doable. Walt Disney World is much more than just its most famous park, Magic Kingdom. The property includes three other main parks, Animal Kingdom, Hollywood Studios, and Epcot, along with the Disney Springs shopping district, multiple water parks and golf courses, and more than two-dozen hotels. The entire property is more than 25,000 acres. Even if Rockstar were to replicate only a portion of the scale of the real Walt Disney World, it would surely be a massive job. Players might expect fully functioning rides, and Nelson said the challenge for Rockstar would be, "Where do you stop? When do you feel like it's enough?" Nelson said people think Rockstar has unlimited time and money, and that isn't true. "So sometimes you just have to admit we are not going to be able to make this to the level we feel we need to,” he said. Plus, as Nelson pointed out, there would need to be a story reason to send Jason and Lucia hundreds of miles north from Miami to Orlando, where Walt Disney World is. GTA 6 has a huge map, but it's contained to Vice City and its surrounding areas--it doesn't go that far north.

The iPhone Duo Is Getting Face Unlock

📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Apple dropped iOS 27.2.1 last week, patching a handful of security vulnerabilities and bugs—including two iMessage flaws that let people read messages they shouldn't.
  • In a recent development, apple is currently beta testing the third major enhancement in the iOS 27 era, and anyone—developer and public tester alike—is free to install it at their leisure.
  • In a recent development, with the second iOS 27.3 developer beta, Apple is introducing face unlock for the iPhone Duo.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Apple dropped iOS 27.2.1 last week, patching a handful of security vulnerabilities and bugs—including two iMessage flaws that let people read messages they shouldn't. But while most of us are running this version (or should install it as soon as possible), others are running something different—iOS 27.3.

In a recent development, apple is currently beta testing the third major enhancement in the iOS 27 era, and anyone—developer and public tester alike—is free to install it at their leisure. With it, comes the return of the Health app, vertical Safari tabs, and Siri AI app actions, among other new features. But for consumers of Apple's first foldable, the iPhone Duo, iOS 27.3 brings two rather notable changes—both of which are for the better.

In a recent development, with the second iOS 27.3 developer beta, Apple is introducing face unlock for the iPhone Duo. The foldable famously ships with Touch ID, the first new iPhone since the third-gen iPhone SE to do so. While that isn't a problem per se, many of us are used to unlocking our iPhones with our faces. This upgrade just lets new Duo owners keep up with that muscle memory.

Now, take note: This isn't Face ID. No software revision can introduce new hardware, so the iPhone Duo still doesn't have the camera tech required to power Apple's Face ID system. As such, the Duo's face unlock is likely not as secure as Face ID on other iPhones. Perhaps that's why your iPhone Duo will require Touch ID for Apple Pay and passwords, or after 45 minutes of inactivity. This feature seems to be one of pure convenience: If you want to be able to unlock your Duo with your face (at least, some of the time), you can.

What's more, this isn't a default setting. If you're running the beta, or if you're reading this after iOS 27.3 drops, you can find the option in Settings > Touch ID & Passcode.

According to recent reports, apple made a big deal about the continuity involved with opening and closing the iPhone Duo. As you do, your content moves with you seamlessly—a very Apple thing to do. That said, you might expect folding the Duo to lock it, but it doesn't. You need to hit the side button to actually put the phone to sleep.

iOS 27.3 changes that. If you so choose, you can enable a setting to lock your Duo whenever you close it. That won't work for everyone, of course—some users may still want to move between modes without worrying about locking their Duos. But for those who would rather lock their devices whenever they fold them up, the latest option is under Settings > Display & Brightness.

Lesley Manville, Pierce Brosnan, and More Celebrate Violinist Joshua Bell at the Langham London

📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • In a recent development, at the age of four, Joshua Bell was given his first violin, and he hasn’t put it down since.
  • Today, the Grammy Award–winning musician is one of the most celebrated classical violinists of his era.
  • That kinship was solidified over coupes of Champagne and hand-dived Orkney scallops, with the hotel celebrating Bell, a “Langham Luminary,” in its London ballroom packed with writers, artists, designers, and musicians.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, at the age of four, Joshua Bell was given his first violin, and he hasn’t put it down since. “I don’t remember falling in love with music,” says Bell. “Music has just been my life. I used to string rubber bands on my dresser drawers and make pitches by pulling the drawers out. I was fascinated with strings. It’s the closest instrument to the human voice. And I find it the most expressive instrument.”.

Today, the Grammy Award–winning musician is one of the most celebrated classical violinists of his era. By 14, Bell was performing with the Philadelphia Orchestra, and would soon be touring the world. “I live in hotels 250 days a year,” notes Bell of the nonstop schedule he has maintained since his teens. Specifically, Bell has been “staying at the Langham for decades now,” he says, referring to the regal central London hotel that first opened in 1865. “I chose it on my own because it was near one of my favorite halls in London, which is the Wigmore Hall. And now I stay with them whenever I’m traveling.”.

That kinship was solidified over coupes of Champagne and hand-dived Orkney scallops, with the hotel celebrating Bell, a “Langham Luminary,” in its London ballroom packed with writers, artists, designers, and musicians.

Attendees included actor Simon Callow, House of Dragon actor Emily Carey, former British culture minister Ed Vaizey, Saturday Night Live UK cast producer Susie Hall, stage and television actor Indira Varma, and Verity actor Ismael Cruz Córdova.

Industry observers note that held in partnership with Vanity Fair, the evening marked the latest iteration of the Langham’s Luminaries in Residence program. The event series is continuation of the hotel’s legacy that brings together a diverse, influential community—an evocative reminder of prominent guests from its storied past, including Charles Dickens, Winston Churchill, George Orwell, Oscar Wilde, and Mark Twain.

According to recent reports, “I’m not going to put my name in the same sentence as Toscanini or Mark Twain—who has stayed here, or Churchill, who has stayed here. But it’s cool to be part of the history,” says Bell. “So maybe someday, in a hundred years, there will be a violinist who might say that—that I stayed here. I don’t know, maybe that would mean something.”.

Sources indicate that it certainly does mean something. Pierce Brosnan and his wife, Keely Shaye Brosnan, “have been huge fans of Joshua for many, many years,” Brosnan tells me. “Keely went to go see him…I don’t know how many years back. Unfortunately, due to the LA traffic, she got there late, five minutes late, and they wouldn’t let her into the concert. So tonight is one of those nights.”.

Bell, who performed mid-dinner with members of the Academy of St. Martin in the Fields—with a surprise appearance from his wife, soprano Larisa Martínez—brought about a collective catharsis.

Industry observers note that dazzling, fiery, and flamboyant, the experience of watching Bell up close is impossible to replicate. “I just think he’s incredibly soulful, and there’s something really elegant,” actor Russell Tovey tells me, before explaining how he actually discovered Bell via his Instagram algorithm.

In a recent development, for actor Lesley Manville, the event marked her introduction to Bell’s music. “I’m a bit embarrassed that he was not on my radar. But isn’t that nice to have a surprise like that?” indicates Manville. “Schubert’s String Quintet is one of my favorite pieces of music. It’s unbelievably beautiful. You think of a violin, you think of those strings. And it’s instant emotion. They just make you cry.”.

There is a great power in being able to access the emotions of others, as Bell does.

“I think it is the ultimate gift to be able to make people happy,” says Brosnan. “My job is being an entertainer—to take the words of great writing and try to transform it into something that is meaningful and memorable.”.

Speaking of entertaining, the week’s announcement that Robert Pattinson will be the next James Bond was front of mind. “I wish him every joy and every success. He and I made a movie a number of years ago called Remember Me. I played his father. So I was very, very pleased and joyful for his nomination and now his success, and I believe he will be magnificent.”.

In a recent development, and that creative full circle is exactly what the night was advocating. “Our own Luminaries in Residence program reflects our belief that meaningful hospitality creates genuine connection with extraordinary talents with one another, and with arts,” Bob van den Oord, CEO of Langham Hospitality Group, explained as he took the stage. “The Langham isn’t simply a place to stay, but a place to gather, exchange ideas, and indeed celebrate.”.

In a post to X, "The Everything App," US entertainment and communications conglomerate Comcast revealed that Grand Theft Auto 6's historic launch drove record-breaking internet traffic. According to Comcast, only a quarter of "the entire internet" was downloading Rockstar's latest cozy game phenomenon.

"GTA 6 didn't just break records in gaming," Comcast wrote. "Its launch drove the biggest internet traffic day in our network history, with traffic climbing 31% above an average day. At peak, GTA 6 accounted for nearly a quarter of all network traffic.".

According to recent reports, comcast shared a video of a line graph showing the massive relative spike in activity on November 19. The chart is unlabeled except for the date, but it presumably corresponds to the volume of data being downloaded across Comcast's entire network.

And that last but does add a caveat to the numbers Comcast cited: Its network and "the entire internet" are two different things, unless I'm missing something here or Comcast's data accounts for other ISPs and other countries, not just its own services.

Recent findings suggest that regardless, it's still a significant bit of fun with statistics, another example of the totalizing footprint of what may be the largest commercial launch in entertainment history. Imagine how much bigger it would have been launching on PC as well.

💡 Key Takeaways

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Grand Theft Auto VIGTA 6MoviesRed Dead Redemption 2Rockstar Games.

With many legacy franchises in decline and few newly introduced ones taking off, Hollywood has turned to video games for substantial box office blockbusters. There have been huge success stories like Minecraft and big bombs like Borderlands. But some of the biggest video game series have yet to make the jump to the silvers screen. Chief among them is Grand Theft Auto. Could that be about to change?

According to a report in The Ankler this week, the answer is no. Multiple sources told the outlet that Rockstar Games isn’t interested in doing a movie adaptation of GTA. It makes sense, in a way, since GTA has increasingly become a series about bringing prestige, cinematic storytelling to the messy, systems-driven gameplay of open-world gaming. Putting that engine in reverse would be a bit like turning the video game version of Indiana Jones back into a movie. Who would ever do that?

But it sounds like Rockstar, owned by Take-Two, is interested in shopping around the rights for a movie or TV adaptation of its Western open-world series, Red Dead Redemption. The Ankler adds that a number of $100 million was at one point thrown around for the price of licensing Red Dead. It points out that Amazon paid $250 million for the TV rights to Lord of the Rings.

Red Dead is in a similar lane to The Last of Us, which HBO managed to thread the needle on making into a prestige television show that still hooked fans of the game. It’s easy to imagine a similarly placed streamer doing the same for Rockstar’s IP, with internal executives pointing to mood boards that include the critical success of things like Deadwood and the commercial appeal of things like Yellowstone.

âWeâre very careful about line extensions because this is a creative tech giant and our goal is to make the best entertainment on earth. Entertainment weâre always proud of,â Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick, who used to be COO at 20th Century Fox, said in an interview on The David Rubenstein Show November 12. âWe would make a movie or television show based on our intellectual property if our creative teams were passionate about it. If they thought that would somehow engage and delight our consumers. Itâs a high bar to do that. And of course, thereâs always a risk of failure. So we donât rule it out, but weâre very, very selective.â.

He’d given shareholders a more detailed account of this reasoning back in 2023 during Hollywood’s Barbenheimer-craze”.

Industry observers note that the hit ratios in the motion picture business are vastly lower than they are in the interactive entertainment business. Our hit ratios for console properties are in the 80 percent or 90 percent. The hit ratio for a well-run movie studio is around 30 percent, which is to say there’s a 70 percent chance that the movie that we license could fail. And so in success, the number, in terms of the benefit to our bottom line…it’s not zero, but it’s not really material to what we do around here. And in failure, we run the risk of compromising the underlying intellectual property.

The race to adapt other popular game franchises is already well underway. According to The Ankler, Amazon, Netflix, and FX are paying between $15 million and $25 million per episode for adaptations of Tomb Raider, Assassin’s Creed, and Far Cry. Those are essentially mid-range Hollywood blockbuster budgets.

It has been revealed that but Take-Two hasn’t rushed to turn its IP into streaming adaptations, and following the disaster that was the Borderlands movie, which was in production prior to it acquiring series maker Gearbox Entertainment, it has good reason to be. It’s games are already breaking sales and revenue records that Hollywood can’t compete with (GTA 6‘s day-one revenue eclipsed Avengers: Endgame). Why jeopardize that for a small side deal? A good Red Dead show could help the game sell ten million more copies, but a bad one could severely hamper its growing popularity beyond traditional gaming audiences.

It has been revealed that “They thought weâd be blinded by the lights and that just wasn’t the case,” Rockstar cofounder Dan Houser, who left to form his own entertainment tech giant, remarked last year when talking about past discussions. “We had what we considered to be multi billion dollar IP, and the economics never made sense. The risk never made sense. In those days, the perception was that games made poor-quality movies.”.

A 2008 adaptation of Max Payne, which Remedy Entertainment developed but Rockstar publishes, starred Mark Wahlberg and was moderately successful at the box office but critically panned with a 15 percent on Rotten Tomatoes. The misstep didn’t doom the series, which eventually got Max Payne 3 and is at the moment slated for remakes of the first two games, but it’s clearly not the sort of thing Rockstar or Take-Two are interested in repeating, especially when legacy movie studios are in the decline and they’re the entertainment industry’s latest big shots.

Apple's latest smartwatch is the Series 12, but don't count out the Series 11. By sacrificing a few of Apple's newest features, you can save some money on the more premium version of this last-gen Apple Watch. Right now, the Titanium Series 11 GPS + cellular model is on sale for $429.

Recent findings suggest that during WWDC 26 earlier this summer, Apple revealed fresh Siri AI upgrades with watchOS 27—but only some Apple Watches have compatibility. Luckily, the Series 11 is one of them, at least for many of them. Some other upgrades in the new OS include a dedicated Siri app, a new app grid, a new single-tap gesture, among other features. Just note that only Series 12 and Ultra 4 can run Audio Intelligence.

The Garmin vivoactive 5 was $299.99 when it first came out in 2023 as their midrange lifestyle-focused fitness smartwatch. It features a 1.2-inch AMOLED touchscreen and an 11-day battery life (four to five days with the always-on display setting). You can get it for $169.99 right now. It's a great option for anyone looking to get into Garmin for the first time or upgrading from anything below it.

Bone conduction headphones are ideal for activities where it is vital to be able to hear your surroundings. They use a technology that sends audio vibrations to your inner ear while leaving your ear canals open. Shokz is one of, if not the best, brands making bone conduction headphones right now. At the high end of Shokz's offerings sit the OpenRun Pro 2, which impressed me when I tested them out for review. Walmart right now has a restored pair for $95 (originally $135.95 and $179.99 new).

Recent findings suggest that the latest AirPods Pro are a major step up. The third iteration of Apple's iconic earbuds comes with a number of quality-of-life and software improvements that make them worth the typical premium over the AirPods Pro 2—and right now, the AirPods Pro 3 are even cheaper than the previous generation. They're $179 on Walmart as an early Black Friday deal, down from $249 and matching their lowest price ever.

Industry observers note that most, if not all, TV speakers aren't great. While you have plenty of options, the quickest and least expensive way to improve your TV's audio capabilities is to buy a soundbar. Compare a soundbar's size to the thin, small speakers jammed into modern TVs. The Vizio 4.1 Pro Soundbar and rear speakers come with Dolby Atmos support and cost just $79 (originally $148). They won't win any audio awards, but it's better than any built-in TV speakers, and for $79, it'll improve your experience without breaking the bank.

If you want to take things up a notch, consider this 5.1 channel sound system. Not only does it include far more channels than a single soundbar, but you're also adding a dedicated subwoofer to the mix. A subwoofer will make those thuds, explosions, and low vibrations much more pronounced than on a soundbar alone. For $149.99 (originally $249.99), you can get the ULTIMEA 5.1 surround sound system, which comes with a soundbar—replicating left, right, and center channels—two rear speakers, and a subwoofer.

Recent findings suggest that I love projectors and Roku. To me, a Roku projector just makes sense, especially at $119.99 (originally $389.99). This projector is portable and has the Roku OS already installed, so it's easy to project it against a wall, ceiling, or screen, whether it's indoors or outdoors. It's easy to set up; you just need an outlet nearby and to dim or turn off the lights. If you have Bluetooth speakers, you can hook them up to create a more immersive sound.

The 98-inch class is heavily discounted at its $898 price (originally $1,499.99). TCL makes one of the best QLEDs for the money, and their technology keeps getting better. This TV supports Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos, and if you're a gamer, you get a refresh rate of 240Hz that is automatically triggered with its Auto Game Mode feature.

According to recent reports, gaming monitors can get pricey fast. At $159.99 (originally $299.99 at launch), this 27-inch Samsung Odyssey G55C curved gaming monitor offers a 1440p resolution, a 1000R curve, a 165Hz refresh rate with FreeSync and G-SYNC compatibility to keep screen tearing to a minimum, and features like Samsung’s Virtual Aim Point and Contrast Enhancer. It's a solid choice for gaming, especially at this price point.

Alienware makes great gaming laptops, and the Aurora is a great option for anyone who wants to get all the essentials without spending too much. At its current $1,099 price (originally $1,999), the Alienware Aurora 16 becomes a mid-tier gaming laptop at a "budget" price. We reviewed the higher-tier Aurora 16X and were impressed with it. The Aurora 16 has a slightly slower processor, a dimmer display with half the refresh rate, a smaller battery, and a weaker graphics card, but given its price, it's great for a gamer looking for a solid gaming laptop in the $1,000 range.

In short, yes, Black Friday still offers discounts that can be rare throughout the rest of the year. If there’s something you want to buy, or you’re shopping for gifts, it’s a good time to look for discounts on what you need, especially tech sales, home improvement supplies, and fitness tech. Of course, if you need to save money, the best way to save is not to buy anything.

Yes. Walmart, Best Buy, Target, and Home Depot will all have in-store deals, some of which you might not find online, so if you're able to take a trip to your local retailer, keep your eyes open for different deals.

According to recent reports, amazon has a much larger inventory of tech products on sale, but the ones they both sell are mostly priced the same. While Amazon may have more deals, Walmart usually has a couple of surprise flagship tech products on sale that Amazon will later price match. So taking all of that into consideration, the best one will be whichever has whatever you're looking to buy at the lower price.

Yes. I own these headphones and can vouch they are worth every penny. The headphones are high quality and bring a hybrid style of open earbuds and bone conduction that I haven't seen in other headphones.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

According to recent reports, the Epic Games Store continues to give away a free game each week, and this week's offering is another nice find at a price that can't be beat. Every Thursday at 8 AM PT / 11 AM ET, Epic offers at least one free PC game (and sometimes even as many as two or three). All you need to do to claim the free games is create a free Epic account and enable two-factor authentication. You have a week to add the freebies to your library before the upcoming one(s) take their place. At this point, Epic has given away hundreds of free games, and there's no sign that the program will stop any time soon. The company has also extended its freebies to Android devices, and you can claim a free game every week here as well. We keep this article up to date weekly to highlight both the current free games and next week's offerings. If you're looking for more freebies, you can check out our list of the 25 best free PC games to play right now, or for more options, the 25 best free games to play on multiple platforms. Current free game at Epic This week's free game is Mark of the Deep, a 2025 pirate-themed adventure with a mix of Metroidvania and soulslike gameplay. Next free games at Epic Next week, you can get a welcome gift pack for Firestone: Idle Clicker Online RPG, and you can help a pair of penguins out in the co-op platformer Bread & Fred. See all free games at Epic Epic Games Store free games list We're keeping a running list of every free game that Epic users have been able to claim in the past. From AAA hits to indie darlings, Epic has really made its mark with free games. You can even snag these games if you don't have a powerful PC so you can play them if you ever get one. The Epic Games Store continues to give away a free game each week, and this week's offering is another nice find at a price that can't be beat. All you need to do to claim the free games is create a free Epic account and enable two-factor authentication. You have a week to add the freebies to your library before the latest one(s) take their place. At this point, Epic has given away hundreds of free games, and there's no sign that the program will stop any time soon. That Big Death In The End Of Oak Street Almost Went Down Very Differently

💡 Key Takeaways

  • Industry observers note that one of the biggest “shock” sounds I’ve made while in a movie theater this year has been for The End of Oak Street.
